confidence_notes: Holistic model estimates from general knowledge of tourist-district pricing; no live listings or booking pages were inspected and no city-price sources were searched. Restaurant, cafe and hostel anchors are moderately certain; hotel anchors are least certain because rates vary widely by property and season (July is rainy-season low season). Cocktail and wine_glass were set from the local beer price relationship because direct knowledge of those prices is weaker. The FX value is from search-result excerpts attributed to RBA exchange-rate pages; the RBA table itself was not opened directly.
comparable_city_reasoning: Regional basis: mainland Southeast Asian secondary tourist cities with backpacker and mid-range markets, similar to other northern Thai destinations, and set below Bangkok and Phuket tourist-district price levels.
